subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC 2 package delivery — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@aurelia.tech>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft & SOC 2 package delivery — next steps

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for a great call this morning. Per our discussion I’m attaching the draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with the security review / SOC 2 package milestone broken out so your security team can track ownership and dates. High level recap: 

- Target close: 2026-09-15 (customer procurement + SOC2 check + contract)
- Current MAP milestone of focus: Security review & SOC 2 package delivery
  - Deliverable: Completed questionnaire + evidence bundle delivered to Aurelia Tech
  - Redwood owner: Marissa Cole (sales/PS)
  - Customer owner: Sarah Johnson (Security lead) + Ethan Moore (IT Ops)
  - Target for evidence handoff: 2026-07-30 (initial), final by 2026-08-06
- Dependencies: Your security review window, Azure infra review (if applicable), legal/contract redlines

Next steps I’ll take this week:
1) Send the SOC 2 package checklist + evidence template (attached).
2) Update MAP with Milestone dates and owners (attached MAP v1).
3) Schedule a 30-min sync with your security team for week of 7/20 to review items they’ll need.

Can you confirm Ethan (cc’d) and your security team are comfortable with the proposed handoff dates? If the 7/30 initial handoff is tight we can shift to 8/3 and compress review on our side.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Draft_AureliaTech_v1.xlsx; SOC2_Package_Checklist.pdf; SOC2_Evidence_Template.docx
From: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@aurelia.tech>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Moore <ethan.moore@aurelia.tech>, Aurelia Tech Security Team <security@aurelia.tech>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC 2 package delivery — next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the summary and the MAP. Appreciate the clear owners and dates. A couple quick notes from our side: 

- We’ve started a security intake review internally. Our security lead (Liu Wei) will be the primary reviewer — I’ve copied the team distribution list above.
- The 7/30 initial handoff is a bit aggressive for us because we have a Q3 audit starting 7/26. Can we move initial handoff to 08/03 and aim to complete by 08/13?
- A couple specific asks from the intake:
  - Can you confirm whether Redwood will provide examples of encryption-at-rest configuration and key management (KMS) integration notes?
  - We’ll need the SOC 2 questionnaire answered and a timeline for when we can expect evidence (logs, access control screenshots, policies).

If you can share the filled questionnaire and the evidence template by 08/03 we’ll prioritize review that week and circle back with any gaps. Also, please include contact for your compliance engineer — we may want a short technical call.

Best,
Sarah Johnson
Head of Security Operations | Aurelia Tech
sarah.johnson@aurelia.tech
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@aurelia.tech>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ethan Moore <ethan.moore@aurelia.tech>
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC 2 package delivery — next steps

Thanks — that timeline works. Updated plan:

- Initial handoff: 2026-08-03 (SOC 2 questionnaire + preliminary evidence bundle)
- Final handoff: 2026-08-13 (remaining evidence and confirmation)
- Technical sync with Redwood compliance engineer: proposed 2026-08-05 10:00AM PT (30 min) — will confirm availability

To answer your questions:
- We will provide KMS integration notes and an encryption-at-rest configuration guide as part of the evidence bundle. See SOC2_Package_Checklist.pdf (attached) for the expected artifacts.
- The SOC 2 questionnaire is attached and we’ll return a completed copy filled with references to where evidence lives in the bundle (screenshots, policy docs, logs).

Who from your team should we add to the calendar invite for the 8/5 sync? I’ll add Redwood’s compliance engineer (Rishi) and Vivek (Solutions Architect).

Action items (owners + dates):
- Marissa (Redwood): Deliver completed questionnaire + preliminary evidence by 2026-08-03; add Rishi & Vivek to technical sync (by 7/23).
- Sarah (Aurelia): Confirm internal reviewer (Liu Wei) and preferred calendar attendee list by 7/23; prioritize initial review week of 8/3.
- Ethan (Aurelia): Provide any environment / infrastructure constraints (Azure subscription IDs, VNet peering notes) by 7/27 if relevant.

I’ll update the MAP spreadsheet with these dates and owners and share the Drive link after this note.

Best,
Marissa

Subject: Internal: Aurelia Tech MAP — prep for compliance sync

Team — quick internal note to align before the 8/5 compliance sync. Summary of what I’ll bring:

1) Filled SOC 2 questionnaire (draft) with pointer links to evidence bundle (we’ll host in shared Drive).
2) Evidence bundle: screenshots for RBAC, IAM policy excerpts, rotatable KMS key config note, sample audit logs (30-day slice), incident response policy, SOC 2 report summary (redacted).
3) Short runbook for the sync: goals = identify any gaps that block procurement; timeline to final handoff 8/13.

Rishi — can you review the questionnaire draft by 7/30 and confirm the exact artifact filenames we’ll include? Vivek — please prepare the KMS note and one-page network diagram for the sync.

I’ll update the MAP spreadsheet (Drive link below) with responsibilities and ship the calendar invite to Aurelia’s full intake group after you both ack.

Drive (MAP + evidence): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-aurelia-tech-map
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-2026-017

Thanks — Marissa
